findings.message: Entry param page (filter:tarefasPedemAcao, persisted) has no state in the definition. Added the public persisted state `page` (number | null) that records the page reached with a pager; qryTarefasPedemAcao(page, append) publishes it only for non-append calls and uses it on load.
public page is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
